verdict.rationale: Lambda's own Cloud API is path-versioned: it is served under /api/v1/, and a runtime probe confirms a live OpenAPI 3.1 spec at that versioned path. Nothing in the evidence documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, or version-change guarantees. missing for 10: a documented deprecation/sunset policy, an API changelog or versioning guarantees, and independent corroboration of version stability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: https://cloud.lambda.ai/api/v1/openapi.json serves the full Lambda Cloud API OpenAPI 3.1 spec
The Lambda Cloud API provides a set of REST API endpoints you can use to create and manage your Lambda Cloud resources.
